name: Foldsquare – Catalog Maker for WooCommerce
author: nowinstore

sections.description:
WooCommerce is great for selling online, but it doesn’t produce the PDF catalogs, lookbooks, and line sheets your wholesale buyers, trade show visitors, and email subscribers actually want. Foldsquare fills that gap: a drag-and-drop catalog builder that plugs directly into your WooCommerce store and turns your products into professionally designed, print-ready catalogs in minutes.

Connect your store in one click and your products, prices, images, and categories sync automatically — no CSV exports, no manual data entry, no design software. Whether you run a fashion boutique, a wholesale distributor, or a retail shop, your catalogs stay up to date the moment your store does.

Why store owners choose Foldsquare:

  • Automatic product sync — Products, prices, images, descriptions, and categories flow from WooCommerce to Foldsquare in real time via the WooCommerce REST API. Update a product in your store and the change appears in your catalog automatically.
  • Professional catalog templates — Start from professionally designed templates for product catalogs, seasonal lookbooks, wholesale line sheets, and promotional brochures. Customize every element to match your brand.
  • Print-ready PDF export — Generate high-resolution PDF catalogs ready for professional printing or digital distribution. Share with customers, sales teams, or trade show attendees.
  • One-click connection — No coding, no API keys to copy and paste. Click “Connect to Foldsquare” and your store is linked in seconds.
  • Secure and revocable — The plugin creates read-only API keys so Foldsquare can only read your product data. Disconnect at any time from your WordPress dashboard to instantly revoke access.

Built for WooCommerce store owners who need:

  • Product catalogs for trade shows, wholesale buyers, or in-store displays
  • Seasonal lookbooks showcasing new collections or curated product lines
  • Promotional brochures for marketing campaigns or mailers
  • Line sheets for wholesale and B2B ordering
  • Digital catalogs to embed on your website or share via email

How it works:

  1. Install the plugin — Upload and activate Foldsquare – Catalog Maker for WooCommerce from your WordPress dashboard, or install it directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Connect your store — Navigate to WooCommerce > Foldsquare and click “Connect to Foldsquare”. The plugin securely links your store using read-only WooCommerce REST API keys.
  3. Design your catalog — Open the Foldsquare catalog builder. Your products, images, prices, and categories are already there. Choose a template or start from scratch, then drag and drop products onto pages.
  4. Export and share — Download your finished catalog as a high-resolution PDF, ready for print or digital distribution. Update your catalog anytime — product changes sync automatically.

External Service:

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Foldsquare, an external catalog builder service operated by Foldsquare Inc. When you click “Connect to Foldsquare”, the plugin:

  • Generates WooCommerce REST API keys (read-only access to products and categories)
  • Sends your store URL and API credentials to https://foldsquare.nowinstore.com over HTTPS
  • Redirects you to Foldsquare to complete the connection

When you disconnect, the plugin notifies Foldsquare at https://foldsquare.nowinstore.com/api/v1/auth/oauth/woocommerce/disconnect to revoke the connection on their end.

By using this plugin, you agree to the Foldsquare Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the foldsquare-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Foldsquare to connect your store.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Foldsquare account?

A Foldsquare account is automatically created for you the first time you connect your store. Just click “Connect to Foldsquare” from WooCommerce > Foldsquare and you’re ready to go — no separate sign-up required.

What permissions does Foldsquare need?

The plugin creates WooCommerce REST API keys with read-only access. Foldsquare can only read your product data and categories — it cannot modify your store, process orders, or access customer information.

Can I disconnect my store?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce > Foldsquare and click “Disconnect”. This immediately revokes the API keys and removes the connection on both ends. You can reconnect at any time.

Is my data secure?

All API keys are transmitted over HTTPS and stored securely on Foldsquare’s servers. The plugin only grants read-only access to products and categories. You can revoke access at any time from the plugin settings page, and Foldsquare deletes the stored credentials upon disconnection.

What types of catalogs can I create?

Foldsquare supports product catalogs, seasonal lookbooks, wholesale line sheets, promotional brochures, and more. You can start from a template or design from scratch using the drag-and-drop builder. Every catalog can be exported as a high-resolution, print-ready PDF.

Does Foldsquare support PDF export?

Yes. Every catalog you create in Foldsquare can be exported as a high-resolution PDF suitable for professional printing, digital distribution, or embedding on your website. PDFs are generated with CMYK-ready color profiles for accurate print reproduction.

Can I customize the catalog design?

Absolutely. The Foldsquare catalog builder gives you full control over layout, typography, colors, and branding. You can customize every element of your catalog — from page dimensions and margins to product card layouts and background images.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Foldsquare syncs all WooCommerce product types, including simple products, variable products with their variations, and grouped products. Product images, prices, and attributes are all available in the catalog builder.

How often do products sync?

Product data syncs automatically when you open or refresh your catalog in Foldsquare. Any changes you make in WooCommerce — new products, updated prices, changed images — are reflected in the catalog builder without any manual action.

Can I use Foldsquare with other e-commerce platforms?

Currently Foldsquare integrates with WooCommerce. Support for additional e-commerce platforms is on the roadmap.
